name: StoryWeaver by Pratham Books
description: An open repository of multilingual illustrated stories and folklore curated to promote mother-tongue reading and cultural storytelling.
attributionText: Content sourced and adapted under CC BY 4.0 from StoryWeaver (Pratham Books).
heritageRole: Supplies accessible, translated folk narratives suitable for multi-sensory reading.

name: Kerala Tourism Official Cultural Heritage Repository
category: Department of Tourism, Government of Kerala
license: Government Open Information / Public Cultural Education
description: Official documentation of Kerala's living performative traditions, folk festivals (Onam, Theyyam, Thrissur Pooram), and heritage monuments.
attributionText: Cultural descriptions and event histories verified against Kerala Tourism Cultural Archives.
heritageRole: Provides authentic state-verified accounts of Onam, Theyyam, and traditional temple arts.

name: Sahapedia — Open Online Resource on Indian Arts & Heritage
description: In-depth peer-reviewed scholarly documentation of Indian rituals, performing arts, folklore, oral histories, and intangible heritage.
attributionText: Ritual performance analysis and Thottam hymn context sourced from Sahapedia's North Malabar and Kerala Performance Archives.
heritageRole: Supplies ethnographic depth for Theyyam invocations, Chakyar Koothu, and indigenous ritual practices.

name: Wikimedia Commons
license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike (CC BY-SA) / Public Domain
description: Community-curated repository of high-resolution cultural photographs, historical paintings, and performative documentation.
attributionText: Photography of Theyyam, Koodiyattam, and Onam festivities credited to individual Wikimedia Commons photographers under CC BY-SA.
heritageRole: Provides authentic visual media for story headers, glossary cards, and illustration overlays.

name: UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
description: Global inventory of living traditions, performing arts, social practices, and traditional craftsmanship.
attributionText: Documentation for Koodiyattam (inscribed 2008) and Mudiyettu (inscribed 2010) referenced from UNESCO Representative List dossiers.
heritageRole: Supplies international preservation benchmarks, safeguarding recommendations, and performance structural records.

name: Digital India Bhashini (National Language Translation Mission)
category: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of India
license: Open Government Data (OGD) / Digital India Initiative
description: National linguistic AI platform advancing Indic language technologies, speech recognition, translation models, and accessibility tools.
attributionText: Linguistic guidelines, Indic phonetic benchmarks, and bilingual evaluation metrics aligned with Bhashini standards.
heritageRole: Guides transliteration schemes, speech synthesis phonetic mapping, and responsible AI translation boundaries.

name: Internet Archive — Public Domain Malayalam & Kerala Collections
license: Public Domain (Pre-1928 Publications & Out-of-Copyright Historical Works)
description: Historical repository containing seminal texts including Herman Gundert's Malayalam-English Dictionary (1872), William Logan's Malabar Manual (1887), and Travancore State Manuals.
attributionText: Historical etymology, folk proverb collections, and early colonial folklore surveys referenced from Internet Archive public domain archives.
heritageRole: Anchors regional idioms in verified 19th-century linguistic and sociological documentation.
